name: roman_numeral
description: Convert between an integer (1-3999) and a Roman numeral (C++). Input: {"value": 1994} to get the numeral, or {"text": "MCMXCIV"} to get the integer back (bare numeral text may also be passed unwrapped).
llm_description: Convert integer (1-3999) <-> Roman numeral. Input: {value: int} for numeral, or {text: "MCMXCIV"} for integer (bare numeral text also accepted).

value.description: Integer 1-3999 to convert to a numeral.

text.description: A Roman numeral to convert to an integer.
